SJS.head: We had this close to even (53% for San Jose), and San Jose came through.

FLA.head: We had this close to even (47% for Florida), and it went San Jose’s way.

surprises.head: San Jose was kept to the outside
surprises.body: San Jose needed 27.0 unblocked shots per expected goal at 5-on-5, against its usual 15.1 and a league average of 15.9. Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 250 games.

surprises.head: Florida brought the hits
surprises.body: Florida’s hit score in the close stretches of the game was 239, against its usual 142 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 100 games.

surprises.head: San Jose’s power play came alive
surprises.body: San Jose’s power play created 17.2 expected goals per 60, against its usual 7.0 and a league average of 7.6. Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 60 games.

surprises.head: San Jose won against the run of play
surprises.body: Replaying this game’s chances, Florida comes out ahead 73 times in 100. San Jose won anyway.
